en.p: A cubic function $f(x)$ satisfies the following conditions.

box: (A) The number of distinct real roots of the equation $f(x)=0$ is 2.
(B) The number of distinct real roots of the equation $f(x-f(x))=0$ is 3.

en.p: When $f(1)=4$, $f'(1)=1$ and $f'(0)>1$, $f(0)=\dfrac{q}{p}$. Find the value of $p+q$. (Here $p$ and $q$ are relatively prime natural numbers.) [4 points]
